ascendancies.name: Deadeye
ascendancies.flavour: A woman can change the world with a single well-placed arrow.

ascendancies.name: Pathfinder
ascendancies.flavour: There are venoms and virtues aplenty in the wilds, if you know where to look.

ascendancies.name: Amazon
ascendancies.flavour: You became a weapon of war so that others could live in peace.

ascendancies.name: Spirit Walker
ascendancies.flavour: You were chosen by the Sacred Wisps to enact the Spirit's will.

ascendancies.name: Ritualist
ascendancies.flavour: Corruption cost you your home, but taught you so much more...

ascendancies.name: Titan
ascendancies.flavour: Incredible might has always laid buried within you. Now is the time to rise.

ascendancies.name: Warbringer
ascendancies.flavour: Your home has been threatened. A good man must be roused to war.

ascendancies.name: Smith of Kitava
ascendancies.flavour: You hunger for power, and by force of arms, you will take it.

ascendancies.name: Tactician
ascendancies.flavour: Countless wars have left you with skills somewhat resembling a decent officer...

ascendancies.name: Witchhunter
ascendancies.flavour: There's something very wrong with this world... and you're going to fix it.

ascendancies.name: Gemling Legionnaire
ascendancies.flavour: The more you embrace virtue gems, the more power they offer...

ascendancies.name: Oracle
ascendancies.flavour: There are many paths to achieve your goals... and you see them all.

ascendancies.name: Shaman
ascendancies.flavour:
Wraeclast has suffered for too long.
You are vengeance incarnate.

ascendancies.name: Infernalist
ascendancies.flavour: You seek power at any cost... and there is no price too high to pay.

ascendancies.name: Blood Mage
ascendancies.flavour: Your search for power took you on a journey inwards.

ascendancies.name: Lich
ascendancies.flavour: Death is your domain, your flesh merely a material to be mastered.

ascendancies.name: Abyssal Lich
ascendancies.flavour: The Well of Souls is yours to command.

ascendancies.name: Stormweaver
ascendancies.flavour: The rumble of thunder heralds your approach. Woe to those that draw your ire.

ascendancies.name: Chronomancer
ascendancies.flavour: The tapestry of time is yours to weave; an element you alone may master.

ascendancies.name: Disciple of Varashta
ascendancies.flavour: By your command, they will earn redemption...one duty at a time.

ascendancies.name: Martial Artist
ascendancies.flavour: They made you a human weapon... but that strength has set you free.

ascendancies.name: Invoker
ascendancies.flavour: True strength lies within. One must only focus... and believe.

ascendancies.name: Acolyte of Chayula
ascendancies.flavour: The truth of your faith threatens to break your very soul... but in that struggle lies power beyond belief.
